phrasing_sets.original: training and tuning phrasings (written together with the retrieval keys)
phrasing_sets.development: independently worded set of review 5, now seen by the developers and tuned against
phrasing_sets.heldout: written before any tuning of the first intent retrieval (intents-v1); not used for tuning; evaluated once, with intents-v1; its adversarial subset is no longer unseen
phrasing_sets.heldout2: written before the tuning of intents-v2; not used for tuning; evaluated once
phrasing_sets.heldout_adversarial: new adversarial and judgement set, written before the screen was extended; not used to choose any pattern; evaluated once

heldout.status: carried over, not re-run: measured the earlier retrieval (intents-v1)

adversarial_subset_unseen.subset: adversarial and judgement questions of the first held-out set
adversarial_subset_unseen.why: its per-question misses (judgement slang such as coima, chanchullo, tongo, negociado, mano negra, coludidos, and hidden-instruction wordings) were read and the screen was then extended to cover that vocabulary; the answerable and unanswerable subsets of the first held-out set were not read per question

baseline_legacy.note: the earlier retrieval (retrieval keys compared with the question), re-measured in this run on the same questions
